							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council meetings</h1>

<p>Council holds two regular meetings each month, on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month. Meetings are usually held in the Queanbeyan chambers and commence at 5:30pm. The first meeting of the newly elected Council will be held on Wednesday 9 October 2024 at the Queanbeyan Council Chambers, 257 Crawford Street.</p>
<p>View or download meeting documents below for Council meetings. If you would like the meeting documents from previous meetings of the former Queanbeyan and Palerang Councils please call us on <a href="tel:1300735025" style="font-size: 1em;">1300 735 025</a> or email <a href="mailto:council@qprc.nsw.gov.au" style="font-size: 1em;">council@qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>.</p>
<h2>Livestream of meetings</h2>
<p>All Council meetings are livestreamed and you can view the meeting at <a href="https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au">https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>. Meetings have been recorded since December 2016 and recordings are available for viewing.</p>
<h2>Public involvement at Council meetings </h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">O</span><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">ur Council meetings are set up to accommodate both councillor and community participation via Zoom. </span></p>
<p>If you'd like to make a presentation on any of the matters on the agenda, you have three options. </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Written presentation - submit by midday on Tuesday before the meeting</li>
<li>Zoom presentation - register by midday on Wednesday</li>
<li>Verbal presentation - register by midday online, or between 5:00pm-5:30pm on Wednesday at the meeting.</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1"><strong>Presentations can be made in writing, in person, or via Zoom. </strong><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;"><strong>Register to make a presentation</strong></span> <strong><a href="https://www.qprc.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Business/Public-involvement-at-Council-meetings#section-2" target="_self" style="font-size: 1em;">online here</a><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">.</span></strong></span></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council meetings</h1>

<p>Council holds two regular meetings each month, on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month. Meetings are usually held in the Queanbeyan chambers and commence at 5:30pm. The first meeting of the newly elected Council will be held on Wednesday 9 October 2024 at the Queanbeyan Council Chambers, 257 Crawford Street.</p>
<p>View or download meeting documents below for Council meetings. If you would like the meeting documents from previous meetings of the former Queanbeyan and Palerang Councils please call us on <a href="tel:1300735025" style="font-size: 1em;">1300 735 025</a> or email <a href="mailto:council@qprc.nsw.gov.au" style="font-size: 1em;">council@qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>.</p>
<h2>Livestream of meetings</h2>
<p>All Council meetings are livestreamed and you can view the meeting at <a href="https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au">https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>. Meetings have been recorded since December 2016 and recordings are available for viewing.</p>
<h2>Public involvement at Council meetings </h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">O</span><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">ur Council meetings are set up to accommodate both councillor and community participation via Zoom. </span></p>
<p>If you'd like to make a presentation on any of the matters on the agenda, you have three options. </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Written presentation - submit by midday on Tuesday before the meeting</li>
<li>Zoom presentation - register by midday on Wednesday</li>
<li>Verbal presentation - register by midday online, or between 5:00pm-5:30pm on Wednesday at the meeting.</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1"><strong>Presentations can be made in writing, in person, or via Zoom. </strong><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;"><strong>Register to make a presentation</strong></span> <strong><a href="https://www.qprc.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Business/Public-involvement-at-Council-meetings#section-2" target="_self" style="font-size: 1em;">online here</a><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">.</span></strong></span></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council meetings</h1>

<p>Council holds two regular meetings each month, on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month. Meetings are usually held in the Queanbeyan chambers and commence at 5:30pm. The first meeting of the newly elected Council will be held on Wednesday 9 October 2024 at the Queanbeyan Council Chambers, 257 Crawford Street.</p>
<p>View or download meeting documents below for Council meetings. If you would like the meeting documents from previous meetings of the former Queanbeyan and Palerang Councils please call us on <a href="tel:1300735025" style="font-size: 1em;">1300 735 025</a> or email <a href="mailto:council@qprc.nsw.gov.au" style="font-size: 1em;">council@qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>.</p>
<h2>Livestream of meetings</h2>
<p>All Council meetings are livestreamed and you can view the meeting at <a href="https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au">https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>. Meetings have been recorded since December 2016 and recordings are available for viewing.</p>
<h2>Public involvement at Council meetings </h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">O</span><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">ur Council meetings are set up to accommodate both councillor and community participation via Zoom. </span></p>
<p>If you'd like to make a presentation on any of the matters on the agenda, you have three options. </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Written presentation - submit by midday on Tuesday before the meeting</li>
<li>Zoom presentation - register by midday on Wednesday</li>
<li>Verbal presentation - register by midday online, or between 5:00pm-5:30pm on Wednesday at the meeting.</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1"><strong>Presentations can be made in writing, in person, or via Zoom. </strong><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;"><strong>Register to make a presentation</strong></span> <strong><a href="https://www.qprc.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Business/Public-involvement-at-Council-meetings#section-2" target="_self" style="font-size: 1em;">online here</a><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">.</span></strong></span></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council meetings</h1>

<p>Council holds two regular meetings each month, on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month. Meetings are usually held in the Queanbeyan chambers and commence at 5:30pm. The first meeting of the newly elected Council will be held on Wednesday 9 October 2024 at the Queanbeyan Council Chambers, 257 Crawford Street.</p>
<p>View or download meeting documents below for Council meetings. If you would like the meeting documents from previous meetings of the former Queanbeyan and Palerang Councils please call us on <a href="tel:1300735025" style="font-size: 1em;">1300 735 025</a> or email <a href="mailto:council@qprc.nsw.gov.au" style="font-size: 1em;">council@qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>.</p>
<h2>Livestream of meetings</h2>
<p>All Council meetings are livestreamed and you can view the meeting at <a href="https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au">https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>. Meetings have been recorded since December 2016 and recordings are available for viewing.</p>
<h2>Public involvement at Council meetings </h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">O</span><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">ur Council meetings are set up to accommodate both councillor and community participation via Zoom. </span></p>
<p>If you'd like to make a presentation on any of the matters on the agenda, you have three options. </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Written presentation - submit by midday on Tuesday before the meeting</li>
<li>Zoom presentation - register by midday on Wednesday</li>
<li>Verbal presentation - register by midday online, or between 5:00pm-5:30pm on Wednesday at the meeting.</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1"><strong>Presentations can be made in writing, in person, or via Zoom. </strong><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;"><strong>Register to make a presentation</strong></span> <strong><a href="https://www.qprc.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Business/Public-involvement-at-Council-meetings#section-2" target="_self" style="font-size: 1em;">online here</a><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">.</span></strong></span></p>

            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {

                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }

                var children = document.body.children;

                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }

            function clearGuard() {

                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;

                }
            }

                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();

                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council meetings</h1>

<p>Council holds two regular meetings each month, on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month. Meetings are usually held in the Queanbeyan chambers and commence at 5:30pm. The first meeting of the newly elected Council will be held on Wednesday 9 October 2024 at the Queanbeyan Council Chambers, 257 Crawford Street.</p>
<p>View or download meeting documents below for Council meetings. If you would like the meeting documents from previous meetings of the former Queanbeyan and Palerang Councils please call us on <a href="tel:1300735025" style="font-size: 1em;">1300 735 025</a> or email <a href="mailto:council@qprc.nsw.gov.au" style="font-size: 1em;">council@qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>.</p>
<h2>Livestream of meetings</h2>
<p>All Council meetings are livestreamed and you can view the meeting at <a href="https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au">https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>. Meetings have been recorded since December 2016 and recordings are available for viewing.</p>
<h2>Public involvement at Council meetings </h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">O</span><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">ur Council meetings are set up to accommodate both councillor and community participation via Zoom. </span></p>
<p>If you'd like to make a presentation on any of the matters on the agenda, you have three options. </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Written presentation - submit by midday on Tuesday before the meeting</li>
<li>Zoom presentation - register by midday on Wednesday</li>
<li>Verbal presentation - register by midday online, or between 5:00pm-5:30pm on Wednesday at the meeting.</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1"><strong>Presentations can be made in writing, in person, or via Zoom. </strong><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;"><strong>Register to make a presentation</strong></span> <strong><a href="https://www.qprc.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Business/Public-involvement-at-Council-meetings#section-2" target="_self" style="font-size: 1em;">online here</a><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">.</span></strong></span></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council meetings</h1>

<p>Council holds two regular meetings each month, on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month. Meetings are usually held in the Queanbeyan chambers and commence at 5:30pm. The first meeting of the newly elected Council will be held on Wednesday 9 October 2024 at the Queanbeyan Council Chambers, 257 Crawford Street.</p>
<p>View or download meeting documents below for Council meetings. If you would like the meeting documents from previous meetings of the former Queanbeyan and Palerang Councils please call us on <a href="tel:1300735025" style="font-size: 1em;">1300 735 025</a> or email <a href="mailto:council@qprc.nsw.gov.au" style="font-size: 1em;">council@qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>.</p>
<h2>Livestream of meetings</h2>
<p>All Council meetings are livestreamed and you can view the meeting at <a href="https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au">https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>. Meetings have been recorded since December 2016 and recordings are available for viewing.</p>
<h2>Public involvement at Council meetings </h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">O</span><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">ur Council meetings are set up to accommodate both councillor and community participation via Zoom. </span></p>
<p>If you'd like to make a presentation on any of the matters on the agenda, you have three options. </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Written presentation - submit by midday on Tuesday before the meeting</li>
<li>Zoom presentation - register by midday on Wednesday</li>
<li>Verbal presentation - register by midday online, or between 5:00pm-5:30pm on Wednesday at the meeting.</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1"><strong>Presentations can be made in writing, in person, or via Zoom. </strong><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;"><strong>Register to make a presentation</strong></span> <strong><a href="https://www.qprc.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Business/Public-involvement-at-Council-meetings#section-2" target="_self" style="font-size: 1em;">online here</a><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">.</span></strong></span></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council meetings</h1>

<p>Council holds two regular meetings each month, on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month. Meetings are usually held in the Queanbeyan chambers and commence at 5:30pm. The first meeting of the newly elected Council will be held on Wednesday 9 October 2024 at the Queanbeyan Council Chambers, 257 Crawford Street.</p>
<p>View or download meeting documents below for Council meetings. If you would like the meeting documents from previous meetings of the former Queanbeyan and Palerang Councils please call us on <a href="tel:1300735025" style="font-size: 1em;">1300 735 025</a> or email <a href="mailto:council@qprc.nsw.gov.au" style="font-size: 1em;">council@qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>.</p>
<h2>Livestream of meetings</h2>
<p>All Council meetings are livestreamed and you can view the meeting at <a href="https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au">https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>. Meetings have been recorded since December 2016 and recordings are available for viewing.</p>
<h2>Public involvement at Council meetings </h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">O</span><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">ur Council meetings are set up to accommodate both councillor and community participation via Zoom. </span></p>
<p>If you'd like to make a presentation on any of the matters on the agenda, you have three options. </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Written presentation - submit by midday on Tuesday before the meeting</li>
<li>Zoom presentation - register by midday on Wednesday</li>
<li>Verbal presentation - register by midday online, or between 5:00pm-5:30pm on Wednesday at the meeting.</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1"><strong>Presentations can be made in writing, in person, or via Zoom. </strong><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;"><strong>Register to make a presentation</strong></span> <strong><a href="https://www.qprc.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Business/Public-involvement-at-Council-meetings#section-2" target="_self" style="font-size: 1em;">online here</a><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">.</span></strong></span></p>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council meetings</h1>

<p>Council holds two regular meetings each month, on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month. Meetings are usually held in the Queanbeyan chambers and commence at 5:30pm. The first meeting of the newly elected Council will be held on Wednesday 9 October 2024 at the Queanbeyan Council Chambers, 257 Crawford Street.</p>
<p>View or download meeting documents below for Council meetings. If you would like the meeting documents from previous meetings of the former Queanbeyan and Palerang Councils please call us on <a href="tel:1300735025" style="font-size: 1em;">1300 735 025</a> or email <a href="mailto:council@qprc.nsw.gov.au" style="font-size: 1em;">council@qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>.</p>
<h2>Livestream of meetings</h2>
<p>All Council meetings are livestreamed and you can view the meeting at <a href="https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au">https://webcast.qprc.nsw.gov.au</a>. Meetings have been recorded since December 2016 and recordings are available for viewing.</p>
<h2>Public involvement at Council meetings </h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">O</span><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">ur Council meetings are set up to accommodate both councillor and community participation via Zoom. </span></p>
<p>If you'd like to make a presentation on any of the matters on the agenda, you have three options. </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Written presentation - submit by midday on Tuesday before the meeting</li>
<li>Zoom presentation - register by midday on Wednesday</li>
<li>Verbal presentation - register by midday online, or between 5:00pm-5:30pm on Wednesday at the meeting.</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="emphasis-box-1"><strong>Presentations can be made in writing, in person, or via Zoom. </strong><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;"><strong>Register to make a presentation</strong></span> <strong><a href="https://www.qprc.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Business/Public-involvement-at-Council-meetings#section-2" target="_self" style="font-size: 1em;">online here</a><span style="font-size: 1em; color: inherit;">.</span></strong></span></p>
